Self.Wiki: World map re-entry point (formerly Map Point Participation Override; the game's CSWorldMapReentryPointIns; vanilla names: 出場領域). The re-entry area of a map point. It has no data of its own: a World Map Point uses it when that point's Re-entry Region Name names this region. Without one, the re-entry area is the World Map Point's own shape, expanded by its Re-entry Expand Range fields. Three retail Map Points use one.
